svg.aria-label: How many Puy-de-Dôme communes each PDO cheese covers. Ripening included, the Saint-Nectaire area covers all 463 communes of the département; the Fourme d'Ambert area, 292.
svg.title: How many Puy-de-Dôme communes each PDO cheese covers
svg.desc: Ripening included, the Saint-Nectaire area covers all 463 communes of the département; the Fourme d'Ambert area, 292. Unit: communes. Option: whole geographic area, ripening included. Perimeter: the 463 communes of Puy-de-Dôme in the 2025 official geographic code; 7 former codes of the INAO list counted in their current commune, which is already listed; Sayat, partly within the Cantal and Salers area, counted whole. Sources: French National Institute of Origin and Quality (INAO), list of communes in AOC and PDO areas (2025-10-09); INAO, AOC, PDO and PGI areas and products (2025-03-10); INAO, register of products under an official quality and origin label (2025-12-31); INAO, specification of the Saint-Nectaire appellation, approved version (2025-11-06); IGN, ADMIN EXPRESS commune boundaries (2025); Insee, official geographic code (2025).
